title: Nobody Answers The Closing PAGE 🛒
description:
At this supermarket, if they page your name at closing, you don't go to the back. Everybody keeps shopping and pretends they didn't hear.

I drive my grandma here every Thursday. Tonight at 9:59 the speakers said my name, and I've never stolen anything in my life.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
